Test provider routing by sending requests to OpenAI and Anthropic

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("OPENAI_API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_async(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(max_tokens: 5, messages: [{ 'content' => 'Say hi.', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'openai/gpt-4o-mini'))
puts result.choices.inspect
```
